exceptions.rationale: proc-macro-error 1.0.4 is pulled only by Tauri's Linux GTK3 proc-macro bindings. The advisory has no patched release; replacing it requires Tauri/Wry to remove that upstream GTK3 graph.

glib 0.18.5 enters through Tauri/Wry's Linux GTK3 graph; GTK and webkit2gtk constrain glib to 0.18, excluding the fixed >=0.20 line. No VariantStrIter call was found in Rice or the inspected immediate upstream sources, but Linux transitive reachability is not proven absent; undefined behavior remains a risk until upstream migrates.
